source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The account test uses assertDeepEqual with strict true for getDefault(false). Its expected rootFolder has no subFolders. The following check deliberately uses a looser comparison when including folders and then asserts both folder fields are arrays. Preserve this distinction when testing absent properties: deleting the property before comparison would hide a null-versus-absence regression.
title: Test omitted fields with an exact object assertion
